findings.issue: §14 says MSG-P3-027 is still to take Standard v4 wording, though R-10054 already set that text. 'Seven texts are legacy/catalogue' is also now untrue.
§15 says the error and no-access states are Not specified, but §14 maps them to MSG-GEN-006 and MSG-P4-001. Loading ownership also reads inconsistently.
The disposition says the composite route field list stays Not specified, but the story states this only for the login name.
§11 calls the ACE batch size a 'page size', and the story omits the batch-operation confirmation that the disposition says is still open.
